kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.doc: Captures and embeds a VNC screenshot of the current Selenium Grid node session in Robot Framework logs.

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Capture Vnc Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures and embeds a VNC screenshot of the current Selenium Grid node session in Robot Framework logs.

You Can take screenshot of the page using this keyword, You can also pass the step number and screenshots number to save the screenshot with the name of step number and screenshots number for PTS uses.

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Capture Vnc Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures and embeds a VNC screenshot of the current Selenium Grid node session in Robot Framework logs.

You Can take screenshot of the page using this keyword, You can also pass the step number and screenshots number to save the screenshot with the name of step number and screenshots number for PTS uses.

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Capture Vnc Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures and embeds a VNC screenshot of the current Selenium Grid node session in Robot Framework logs.

You Can take screenshot of the page using this keyword, You can also pass the step number and screenshots number to save the screenshot with the name of step number and screenshots number for PTS uses.

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Capture Vnc Screenshot

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Capture Vnc Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures and embeds a VNC screenshot of the current Selenium Grid node session in Robot Framework logs.

You Can take screenshot of the page using this keyword, You can also pass the step number and screenshots number to save the screenshot with the name of step number and screenshots number for PTS uses.

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Capture Vnc Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures and embeds a VNC screenshot of the current Selenium Grid node session in Robot Framework logs.

You Can take screenshot of the page using this keyword, You can also pass the step number and screenshots number to save the screenshot with the name of step number and screenshots number for PTS uses.

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Capture Vnc Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures and embeds a VNC screenshot of the current Selenium Grid node session in Robot Framework logs.

You Can take screenshot of the page using this keyword, You can also pass the step number and screenshots number to save the screenshot with the name of step number and screenshots number for PTS uses.

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Capture Vnc Screenshot

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Capture Vnc Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures and embeds a VNC screenshot of the current Selenium Grid node session in Robot Framework logs.

You Can take screenshot of the page using this keyword, You can also pass the step number and screenshots number to save the screenshot with the name of step number and screenshots number for PTS uses.

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Capture Vnc Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures and embeds a VNC screenshot of the current Selenium Grid node session in Robot Framework logs.

You Can take screenshot of the page using this keyword, You can also pass the step number and screenshots number to save the screenshot with the name of step number and screenshots number for PTS uses.

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Capture Vnc Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures and embeds a VNC screenshot of the current Selenium Grid node session in Robot Framework logs.

You Can take screenshot of the page using this keyword, You can also pass the step number and screenshots number to save the screenshot with the name of step number and screenshots number for PTS uses.

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Capture Vnc Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures and embeds a VNC screenshot of the current Selenium Grid node session in Robot Framework logs.

You Can take screenshot of the page using this keyword, You can also pass the step number and screenshots number to save the screenshot with the name of step number and screenshots number for PTS uses.

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Capture Vnc Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures and embeds a VNC screenshot of the current Selenium Grid node session in Robot Framework logs.

You Can take screenshot of the page using this keyword, You can also pass the step number and screenshots number to save the screenshot with the name of step number and screenshots number for PTS uses.

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Capture Vnc Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures and embeds a VNC screenshot of the current Selenium Grid node session in Robot Framework logs.

You Can take screenshot of the page using this keyword, You can also pass the step number and screenshots number to save the screenshot with the name of step number and screenshots number for PTS uses.

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Capture Vnc Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures and embeds a VNC screenshot of the current Selenium Grid node session in Robot Framework logs.

You Can take screenshot of the page using this keyword, You can also pass the step number and screenshots number to save the screenshot with the name of step number and screenshots number for PTS uses.

kw.name: Take Desktop Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures a full desktop screenshot and embeds it directly into Robot Framework logs. This keyword takes a screenshot of the entire desktop using `pyautogui`, converts it to a base64-encoded image, and embeds it directly into the Robot Framework `log.html` report. The screenshot is processed entirely in memory—no local files are created. **Arguments**: - `width` (int, optional, default=800): The width (in pixels) for displaying the screenshot in the Robot log. Controls the size of the embedded image. **Behavior**: - Captures the current desktop image in memory. - Converts the image to base64 format. - Embeds the screenshot inline in the Robot Framework log as an HTML `` tag. - Does not save the screenshot to disk. **Raises**: - `Exception`: If the screenshot capture fails due to permission issues, missing display context, or runtime errors. **Returns**: - `None`: The screenshot is logged in Robot Framework; no object is returned. **Example Usage in Robot Framework**: ``` Take Desktop Screenshot Take Desktop Screenshot 1024 ``` **Notes**: - Ideal for debugging GUI or desktop-based automation workflows. - The `width` parameter allows resizing for better visibility in reports.

kw.name: Capture Vnc Screenshot
kw.doc: Captures and embeds a VNC screenshot of the current Selenium Grid node session in Robot Framework logs.

You Can take screenshot of the page using this keyword, You can also pass the step number and screenshots number to save the screenshot with the name of step number and screenshots number for PTS uses.
